$comment: The version is computed from Conventional Commit types, which is release-please's default: fix -> patch, feat -> minor, feat! or BREAKING CHANGE -> major. This replaces always-bump-minor, under which every release was a minor and a patch release could not be expressed at all. CONTRIBUTING.md already requires Conventional Commits, so the history supports this. The agents' pyproject.toml files are deliberately NOT listed here: they carry independent versions and are not the project version -- the SDK in particular releases separately to PyPI via publish-sdk.yml and its sdk-v* tags.
